registration.name: xl-cand3r
changes_against_run3: id, hypothesis, competing_explanations, expected_*: R42 wording
registration: R42 block (software commit, tree identity, knobs); the run-3 block is kept as derived_from
steps[].argv --manifest and sources: the manifest is read from {home}/r42/reg/NAME/ (outside the measured tree, so the tree stays byte-equal to its commit) instead of spec/r41/run3/board/
board.memory_map.source and sources: {home}/r41run3/xclbin_hbm_map.json (same file, same sha256) instead of spec/r41/run3/xclbin_hbm_map.json, which is not in the repository
estimates: removed (only --dry-run reads them; evidence/ is not staged)

identity manifest: the `source` step (review of the frozen RTL image source archive, an R41 delivery check) and its two tool sources are removed; the clock verification and the three identity points are unchanged
optional --knob entries are added to every configuration (none for the baseline)

board_batches: the batch `xl` lists the points of archbench/suites/xl.json in file order (coverage-checked against the same file) instead of the 113 original points; the suite file sha256 is registered in `suites`
steps[0]: id `xl`, run through the registered copy of tools/r42/xl_board_batch.py (a subclass of board_batch.Batch) instead of board_batch.py directly; outputs under {out}/xl

configurations[].timeout_seconds: per-point process timeout, max(1200 s, 4 x the point estimate.seconds_pessimistic of xl.json, the larger of the two planning estimates there: the nominal one assumes an FP8 efficiency that no board run has confirmed); the run-3 value was the plan budget (28800 s) for every point

sampling: the device rule is unchanged (a qualification record, then 3 timed samples in a new process for points at <= 1 s device time); in addition a point whose qualification process took more than 300 s of wall time keeps the qualification record as its only formal record

board_batches.xl: only the point(s) ['model.fp8_decoder_prefill/xl/fp8-b1-s512-layers28'] (a repeat that completes xl-cand3: their only attempt there ended without any measurement because another user loaded a different image); `coverage` is omitted for this subset (board_batch.py checks full coverage of the suite file only when it is given); the suite file and every point definition sha256 are still registered and checked
registration.sampling: unchanged: spec/r41/stage1/plan.json measurement.long_device_tasks (qualification record 0 warm-up + 1 timed call; a point at <= 1 s device time then gets a formal record of 3 timed calls in a new process, else the qualification record is formal); xl: additionally the qualification record is the only formal record when its process took more than 300 s of wall time
registration.boundary: unchanged: ArchBench protocol 2, device-cycles-serial-grid at the qualified 100 MHz

suite.name: xl
suite.tolerances: the frozen per-point tolerances of the suite file; none changed
suite.timeout_rule: max(1200 s, 4 x estimate.seconds_pessimistic of the point in the suite file)
suite.sampling_cap: a qualification process above 300 s of wall time is the formal record (1 sample)

memory_map.note: unchanged run-3 map (explicit 8 GiB HBM_STRIPED allocation, MBG[0:31]); the run-3 heap capacity is 8 GiB - 4 KiB, above the 3 GiB live cap of the xl points (tools/r42/xl_memory_check.py reads it from the run-3 records)
